Session: `session_01SJn1GEkrbbBQkhGC26wEDw`
Account: `os-sales` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-12873-objectstack-next-3`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12873` (in the cloud session's own container)
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#4`
File surface:
- every workspace `package.json` that names `@objectstack/*` (a range's floor raised only where a held card needs `next.3`);
- `pnpm-lock.yaml` (regenerated by pnpm, never by hand);
- the files a `next.3` red points to (contract-following, the smallest change), each named in the PR's red table;
- one `.changeset/12873-*.md`.

The held cards objectui#12490 and objectui#12333 keep their own items and land after this PR.

Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `L`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (cloud on the maintainer's stance 「可以的话，ui 后续开发尽量用云 session，并且要求截图给我看」; lane scope on 「你也可以接ui车道的卡」; batch 3 on 「当前任务处理完，后续并发降到3」, this session's chat, 2026-10-16)
Clause-②: yes
Clause-② reason: `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/app-shell` re-export `@objectstack/spec` types, and a 158-commit release range can move objectui's published surface in either direction («拿不准 ⇒ 按 yes»). The seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` review comes before ready.
Responsibility: n/a — a dependency bump, not a defect card
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared:
- No open objectui PR touches `pnpm-lock.yaml` or a workspace `package.json` except dependabot objectui#11845 / #11844 on `apps/site` (read at dispatch).
- This seat's in-flight objectstack-ai/objectui#12874 (objectui#11815) touches `fields`, `core`, `types` and the plugin hosts, not the lockfile. Whichever lands second merges `main`.
